ghidra_exception.reason: The stock Ghidra view joins both depth branches at the byte-store and mutex-unlock epilogue, while the candidate view duplicates balanced cleanup and renders the diagnostic path as an early return. The two-call surface, field offsets 0x40 and 0x10, exact 104-byte body and P-Code operation shape agree.

claim: The candidate preserves the stock syna_tcm_buf_unlock function at the offline function level: 104 bytes, 26 AArch64 instructions, equivalent normalized relocations, matching KCFI and matching P-Code operation shape, with the 14-test host contract passing twice under ASan/UBSan.
limitations: Android runtime, kernel integration and NX809J physical hardware behavior remain unverified.
